oOkM98Mtj8pHzXTcD_ZjZw.zh: 摩洛哥中北部蘇斯-馬塞大區(Souss-Massa)有2起家庭群聚,截至今年9/28,經實驗室檢驗1例確定病例、8例調查中。當局已針對密切接觸者進行追蹤、預防性投藥及疫苗接種等防治措施。
oOkM98Mtj8pHzXTcD_ZjZw.en: Two household clusters have been detected in the Souss-Massa region of central-northern Morocco. As of 28 September this year, one case has been confirmed by laboratory testing and eight cases are under investigation. Authorities have implemented control measures for close contacts, including contact tracing, preventive medication and vaccination.

_1us1I8gl2vFEScXV_045Q.zh: 俄羅斯鄂木斯克州自 2026 年 4 月初起,通報 3 例人類狂犬病確定死亡病例。個案均為被家中貓狗咬傷後,未及時尋求或拒絕暴露後預防接種(PEP)而發病致死。該國每年記錄 2-6 例死亡案例,鄂木斯克州於今年 5 月底已達到/超過全國年度死亡數下限。 義大利威托大區 1 例自摩洛哥非法輸入犬隻於 5/27 確定染病,並遭安樂死,目前無人類感染病例。此為該國近 15 年來首度通報動物個案,專家強調須落實跨部門「健康一體」(One Health)的應對機制,嚴遵守跨國移動的動物檢疫與疫苗規範,才能有效防範人畜共通傳染病的再次爆發。
_1us1I8gl2vFEScXV_045Q.en: Omsk Oblast in the Russian Federation has reported three confirmed human rabies deaths since early April 2026. All patients were bitten by household cats or dogs and did not seek, or refused, timely post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), and died as a result. The country records two to six rabies deaths each year, and Omsk Oblast had reached or exceeded the national annual lower limit for deaths by late May this year. In Italy's Veneto Region, one dog illegally imported from Morocco was confirmed infected with rabies on 27 May and was euthanised. No human infections have been reported. This is the first animal case reported in the country in nearly 15 years. Experts stress the need for a cross-sectoral One Health response, with strict compliance with animal quarantine and vaccination rules for cross-border movement, to prevent a recurrence of zoonotic outbreaks.

g45biwqn8p7NoSgSXUqOJw.zh: 英國報告1例境外移入死亡病例,為59歲女性,於今(2025)年2月前往摩洛哥旅遊期間遭犬隻抓傷,於6月上旬出現頭痛、無法行走、說話、睡覺及吞嚥等症狀後死亡。該國於2020-24年累計報告6例境外移入病例,當局呼籲民眾前往高風險國家應儘可能避免接觸犬貓及其他動物,並於旅行前諮詢是否需要接種狂犬病疫苗。
g45biwqn8p7NoSgSXUqOJw.en: The United Kingdom reported an imported death: a 59-year-old woman who was scratched by a dog during a trip to Morocco in February this year. In early June she developed headache and was unable to walk, speak, sleep or swallow, and she died. The UK recorded 6 imported cases cumulatively in 2020–24. Authorities urge people travelling to high-risk countries to avoid contact with dogs, cats and other animals as far as possible, and to consult before travel about whether rabies vaccination is needed.

CJzXSa5hFu9g8jF9HiROBg.zh: 西班牙報告1例境外移入病例,為44歲男性,於去(2024)年7月前往衣索比亞旅行期間腿部遭狗咬傷,僅進行傷口清洗,未進行狂犬病暴露後預防(PEP)治療,約10個月後出現發燒、情緒波動及恐水症等症狀住院治療,5/29確診後,注射免疫球蛋白,仍於6/6死亡。另患者妻子為唯一接觸者,已注射疫苗及免疫球蛋白,目前狀況良好。該國最近1例死亡病例為2019年自摩洛哥境外移入病例。
CJzXSa5hFu9g8jF9HiROBg.en: Spain reported one imported case, a 44-year-old man who was bitten on the leg by a dog during a trip to Ethiopia in July last year. He only had the wound cleaned and did not receive post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). About 10 months later he developed fever, emotional changes and hydrophobia, and was hospitalized. He was confirmed on 29 May, received immunoglobulin, and died on 6 June. His wife, the only contact, has received vaccine and immunoglobulin and is doing well. Spain's most recent rabies death was an imported case from Morocco in 2019.

eTwNsoalPwviurRM_Bytwg.zh: 美洲:美國今年截至5/29報告14起疫情,累計33州1,088例,其中133例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾740例為多,近期德州地區疫情已趨緩,惟其他州仍持續報告零星病例,南達科他州報告今年首例;墨西哥今年截至5/12報告逾 4,200例,其中1,520例確診及4例死亡,以奇瓦瓦州(1,434)為多。 亞洲:吉爾吉斯今年截至5/27累計報告逾7,300例,主要分布於首都比斯凱克,另北部楚河州及南部奧什州病例數亦較高,疫情分布廣泛,遍及都會及農村地區,94%病例未接種疫苗;蒙古今年迄今報告3,100餘例,病例主要集中於校園,當局呼籲學生、教職員及與學齡族群密切接觸人員接種疫苗。 非洲:摩洛哥今年累計報告超過40,000例,其中79例死亡(CFR:0.2%),目前當局持續進行全國性疫苗接種。
eTwNsoalPwviurRM_Bytwg.en: Americas: as of 29 May this year, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,088 cases cumulatively across 33 states, including 133 hospitalizations and 3 deaths. Texas has the most, with over 740 cases. The Texas outbreak has recently slowed, but other states continue to report sporadic cases, and South Dakota reported its first case this year. As of 12 May, Mexico had reported over 4,200 cases this year, including 1,520 confirmed cases and 4 deaths, mainly in Chihuahua State (1,434). Asia: as of 27 May this year, Kyrgyzstan has reported over 7,300 cases cumulatively, mainly in the capital Bishkek, with high numbers also in the northern Chui Region and the southern Osh Region. The outbreak is widespread across urban and rural areas, and 94% of cases were unvaccinated. Mongolia has reported over 3,100 cases so far this year, concentrated in schools, and authorities urge students, school staff and people in close contact with school-age children to be vaccinated. Africa: Morocco has reported more than 40,000 cases cumulatively this year, including 79 deaths (CFR 0.2%), and nationwide vaccination is ongoing.

JID15r3l9zYEN3QeVd_R_w.zh: 摩洛哥自2023年10月爆發疫情以來,截至今年4/13全國共12個地區報告2.5萬餘例疑病例,其中1.3萬餘例確診及184例死亡,該國於今年1月下旬達高峰後,已連續10週呈下降趨勢,經基因定序顯示多為B3基因型,該基因型於非洲地區流行,亦與全球疫情相關。目前疫情已受控制,惟部分地區仍持續傳播,惟該國麻疹-德國麻疹(MR)疫苗接種率僅73.6%,WHO評估該國未接種疫苗/未完全接種疫苗者與免疫功能低下者風險為「中」,由於處非/歐洲交接處,人員流動頻繁,評估區域及全球風險為「中」。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/8報告14起疫情,累計31州1,001例,其中126例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,今年僅4個多月,病例數已接近2019年全年病例數(1,274),其為1992年以來病例數最高峰;加拿大今年截至4/26共7省1,506例,以安大略省(1,249)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/12累計報告362例;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告954例,其中1例死亡,該國今年迄今累計1,003例。 澳大利亞爆發近6年來最嚴重疫情,今年迄今累計報告72例,超過去(2024)年全年病例數(57例),分布以維多利亞州27例為多,其次為新南威爾斯州(21)及西澳大利亞州(18),超過6成病例為29歲以下族群。
JID15r3l9zYEN3QeVd_R_w.en: Morocco: since its outbreak began in October 2023, as of 13 April this year, 12 regions nationwide have reported more than 25,000 suspected cases, of which more than 13,000 were confirmed and 184 died. The country peaked in late January this year and has since declined for 10 consecutive weeks. Genetic sequencing shows that most cases are genotype B3, which circulates in Africa and is also linked to the global outbreak. The outbreak is now under control, but transmission continues in some areas. Morocco's measles-rubella (MR) vaccination coverage is only 73.6%. WHO assesses the risk for unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated people and immunocompromised people in the country as moderate. Because the country sits at the junction of Africa and Europe with frequent population movement, the regional and global risk is also assessed as moderate. North America update: as of 8 May, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,001 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 126 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. In just over four months this year, case numbers are close to the 2019 full-year total (1,274), the highest since 1992. As of 26 April, Canada had 1,506 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,249); Alberta's case numbers have risen rapidly, with 362 cases reported cumulatively as of 12 May. The outbreak in Chihuahua State in northern Mexico is severe, with 954 cases reported this year so far, including 1 death; the country has reported 1,003 cases so far this year. Australia is experiencing its most severe outbreak in nearly six years, with 72 cases reported so far this year, exceeding last year's full-year total (57 cases). Victoria had the most (27 cases), followed by New South Wales (21) and Western Australia (18). More than 60% of cases were aged 29 years or younger.

7SB9FK0sqIkDoUqxTsbclg.zh: 全球疫情嚴峻:  非洲:今年迄今累計7國報告2.1萬餘例疑病例,其中確診3,600餘例及54例死亡,病例集中於摩洛哥,今年迄今報告超過2萬例及37例死亡。 歐洲:ECDC更新2025年1月麻疹資訊,17國報告1,033例,其中以羅馬亞663例為多,其次為義大利74例及西班牙70例,餘14國報告病例數為1-67例。歐盟多國仍持續發生疫情,去年病例數遽增,全年報告3.2萬餘例,其中19例死亡,ECDC表示依據疾病季節模式,評估今年春季病例數將持續增加。因歐洲多數國家皆未達到完整接種之水準,呼籲各國應積極接種。荷蘭今年迄2月累計報告63例,多數病例為境外移入及其接觸者,境外移入病例多來自摩洛哥及羅馬亞。 亞洲:越南河內市近1週(2/28-3/7)新增120例,今年迄今累計報告745例,去年同期則無報告病例;日本第9週(2/27-3/5)新增4例,為今年以來新高,該國累計報告9例,多為境外移入,近期千葉縣及埼玉縣各報告1例自越南移入個案。 美洲:美國德州及新墨西哥州疫情持續,今年截至3/11累計報告256例(德州223例),其中30例住院,2例死亡;加州洛杉磯郡報告今年首例,病患具臺灣旅遊史,於3/5返國,目前相關單位調查中。美洲地區今年截至2/21,共4國報告268例,顯著高於去年同期之60例。
7SB9FK0sqIkDoUqxTsbclg.en: Global outbreaks remain severe. Africa: so far this year, 7 countries have reported over 21,000 suspected cases, including over 3,600 confirmed and 54 deaths. Cases are concentrated in Morocco, which has reported over 20,000 cases and 37 deaths this year. Europe: ECDC has updated its measles data for January 2025. 17 countries reported 1,033 cases, of which Romania had 663, followed by Italy with 74 and Spain with 70; the remaining 14 countries reported 1–67 cases each. Several EU countries continue to have outbreaks. Cases surged last year, with over 32,000 reported for the full year, 19 of them fatal. ECDC says that based on seasonal patterns, case numbers are expected to keep rising this spring. Because most European countries have not reached full vaccination levels, it calls on countries to vaccinate actively. The Netherlands reported 63 cases so far this year up to February; most were imported cases and their contacts, mainly from Morocco and Romania. Asia: Hanoi, Viet Nam, added 120 cases in the past week (28 February–7 March), with 745 cases reported so far this year and none in the same period last year. Japan added 4 cases in week 9 (27 February–5 March), the highest this year; it has reported 9 cases cumulatively, mostly imported, and recently one imported case each from Viet Nam was reported in Chiba and Saitama prefectures. Americas: outbreaks continue in Texas and New Mexico, USA; as of 11 March, 256 cases had been reported this year (223 in Texas), of which 30 were hospitalized and 2 died. Los Angeles County reported its first case this year, in a patient with a travel history to Taiwan who returned on 5 March; investigation is ongoing. As of 21 February, 4 countries in the Americas had reported 268 cases this year, well above the 60 in the same period last year.

h_xg-piVxeSpDZ0OX4I9ow.zh: 北非摩洛哥、突西亞於去年第四季,各新增至少1例狂犬病死亡病例,病患均曾經犬隻咬傷,疫苗接種史不明;西亞以色列亦報告近8年來首例病例,為經犬隻咬傷,目前仍住院治療,當局已對接觸者進行預防接種;南亞印度馬哈拉什特拉邦新增至少1例死亡病例,病患曾被流浪犬貓咬傷,因無傷口而未接種疫苗。
h_xg-piVxeSpDZ0OX4I9ow.en: In North Africa, Morocco and Tunisia each reported at least one new rabies death in the fourth quarter of last year. All patients had been bitten by dogs, and their vaccination history is unknown. In West Asia, Israel reported its first case in nearly eight years, a person bitten by a dog, who is still hospitalised; authorities have given post-exposure vaccination to contacts. In South Asia, Maharashtra State in India reported at least one new death; the patient had been bitten by a stray dog or cat and, because there was no wound, had not been vaccinated.

dxO7vWafGaUdxOnyEtOGDg.zh: 南亞越南今年疫情驟升,截至12/21累計報告近5千例病例,已逾去年病例數百倍,分布以胡志明市佔1,800例最多,目前疫情仍持續,近期北部省份疫情亦有上升趨勢,研判此波疫情為自然疾病週期和低疫苗接種率之結果;柬埔寨今年疫情亦上升,截至12/22累計17省報告375例病例,當局呼籲家長確保孩童接種疫苗。 北美加拿大安大略省今年截至12/18累計報告63例病例,較去年之7例大幅上升,其中1例死亡,病患中有37例與新布藍茲維省麻疹群聚事件有關,多數病例未接種疫苗。 東歐烏克蘭今年截至11月累計報告333例病例,為去年同期之6倍,近期西南部車夫契州疫情上升,當局表示已在控制之中,惟仍呼籲兒童及孕婦接種疫苗。 北非摩洛哥北部丹吉爾-得土安-胡塞馬大區近期疫情上升,已知謝夫沙萬省及得土安省已分別報告50及70例病例,並有至少3例兒童死亡案例。
dxO7vWafGaUdxOnyEtOGDg.en: In South-East Asia, Viet Nam's measles outbreak has surged this year: as of 21 December, nearly 5,000 cases had been reported cumulatively, more than a hundredfold increase over last year's total. Ho Chi Minh City accounts for the largest share, with 1,800 cases. The outbreak is still ongoing, and case numbers have recently been rising in northern provinces too. Authorities attribute this wave to the natural disease cycle and low vaccination coverage. In Cambodia, cases have also risen this year: as of 22 December, 375 cases had been reported cumulatively across 17 provinces, and authorities urge parents to make sure their children are vaccinated. In North America, Ontario, Canada, reported 63 cases cumulatively as of 18 December this year, sharply up from 7 cases last year; one patient died. Of these cases, 37 were linked to the measles cluster in New Brunswick Province, and most cases were unvaccinated. In Eastern Europe, Ukraine reported 333 cases cumulatively as of November this year, six times the same period last year. Cases have recently risen in the south-western Chernivtsi Oblast; authorities say the situation is under control but still urge children and pregnant women to be vaccinated. In North Africa, cases have risen recently in the Tangier-Tétouan-Al Hoceima region of northern Morocco. Chefchaouen and Tétouan provinces have reported 50 and 70 cases respectively, and at least three child deaths have occurred.

_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續上升,單週新增病例數突破200例,今年截至11/22累計報告逾1,800例,其中3例死亡,當局已加強疫苗接種措施。 吉爾吉斯今年截至9月累計報告13,358例病例,疫情於6月達高峰後持續下降,目前已趨緩,病例多分布於北部及西南部州別,當局已加強疫苗接種。 非洲疫情持續,今年截至11/8累計報告23萬2,363例病例,其中21,214例確診,3,136例死亡(CFR:1.35%),以剛果民主共和國報告9.2萬餘例最為嚴峻、另有衣索比亞、蒲隆地、摩洛哥、索馬利亞、奈及利亞及布吉納法索報告1至2.8萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,21國報告數十至5千例不等。
_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.en:
Viet Nam: In Ho Chi Minh City, the outbreak continues to rise, with weekly new cases exceeding 200. As of 22 November this year, more than 1,800 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 3 deaths, and authorities have stepped up vaccination measures.

Kyrgyzstan: As of September this year, 13,358 cases have been cumulatively reported. The outbreak peaked in June and has declined since, and is now slowing. Cases are mainly distributed in the northern and south-western regions, and authorities have stepped up vaccination.

Africa: The outbreak continues. As of 8 November this year, 232,363 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 21,214 confirmed cases and 3,136 deaths (CFR: 1.35%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo has been most severely affected, reporting more than 92,000 cases. Ethiopia, Burundi, Morocco, Somalia, Nigeria and Burkina Faso each reported between 1 and more than 28,000 cases; Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to more than 8,000 cases; and 21 countries reported from several dozen to 5,000 cases.

Mi7mhyVVSmRwhe_K3pD3jQ.zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年截至9/26累計報告21萬8,258例病例,其中19,454例確診,2,968例死亡(CFR:1.25%),以剛果民主共和國8.5萬餘例、衣索比亞2.7萬餘例最多,另有蒲隆地、摩洛哥、奈及利亞、布吉納法索及索馬利亞報告1萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,19國報告數十至5千例不等。 越南南部胡志明市疫情上升,9月底單週新增近百例病例,自疫情爆發(時間不明)截至9/26累計報告達743例,多為5歲以下兒童,當局表示該市之免疫覆蓋率於各地區差異大,目前已超過72%;另報載該國中、北部省份疫情亦在上升。
Mi7mhyVVSmRwhe_K3pD3jQ.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. As of 26 September this year, 218,258 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 19,454 were confirmed and 2,968 died (CFR: 1.25%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo (over 85,000) and Ethiopia (over 27,000) account for the most cases. Burundi, Morocco, Nigeria, Burkina Faso and Somalia each reported over 10,000 cases, Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to 8,000 cases, and 19 countries reported between several dozen and 5,000 cases. In southern Viet Nam, cases in Ho Chi Minh City have risen. Nearly 100 new cases were reported in the last week of September, and since the outbreak began (date unspecified), 743 cases have been reported cumulatively as of 26 September, mostly children under 5. Authorities say immunization coverage differs widely across districts in the city and currently exceeds 72%. Media reports also indicate that cases are rising in central and northern provinces of the country.
